# Aquatic movement, from every angle.

Explore a deterministic five-fish simulation in a conceptual 3D tank.
Scrub time, play motion, change the projection, and inspect individual
trajectories. No images or trajectories are taken from real fish, and
displayed units are arbitrary.

**Isometric 3D projection**Paused · frame 0

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

**What you are seeing:** original deterministic curves and simplified
orthographic projections. Neither a real 3D reconstruction nor a
validated biological fish simulator. Real studies must supply physical
camera calibration, fish ID reference labels, actual timestamps and
measured XYZ uncertainty.
